topic: Lite window bound is snapshotted at open
lesson: forge mode done compares the committed diff against the window's recorded max_files, not harness.yaml, so raising modes.lite.bound mid-window cannot close it; a finished 6-file fix had to be ledgered as abandoned. Upstream (symphony-forge): let mode done honor the current config bound, or add an owner override with --by. Until then, size the window before opening or extract modules in a separate window.
